description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'Permissions' that handles filtering user roles based on permissions within the Views module. It includes methods for retrieving permission options and querying roles with specific permissions.

classes.name: Permissions
classes.description: A filter handler class for filtering user roles by permissions in Drupal Views.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the Permissions class, initializes permission handler and module extension list, with deprecation warning for certain argument types.

methods.name: getValueOptions
methods.description: Retrieves and caches permission options for filtering, grouped by provider display name.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Filters roles based on selected permissions, loading roles that have the specified permissions.
